SEARCH
Package app

Class Main

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
app.Main
public class Main extends javafx.application.Application
Starts the Sharetea POS. Picks the data source (the database when db.properties exists, otherwise sample data), shows the login screen, and swaps screens inside one window.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Opens the data store and shows the login screen. Any error a screen doesn't handle (usually a failed query) shows up as a dialog, and closing the main window quits, even if the customer display is still open.
      Specified by:
      start in class javafx.application.Application
      Parameters:
      stage - the main window JavaFX creates
